title: helianthemum vulgare subsp. chamaecistus
intro: Helianthemum vulgare subsp. chamaecistus, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Cistaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating skin conditions such as eczema, wounds, and burns, due to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Rock Rose include its ability to soothe and protect the skin, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Rock Rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
